fields.finding: 30 kg sealed hardware includes an assumed 10 kg power package. Even if all ten kilograms were battery, the stated pack factors support five-watt monitoring for only nine days. Gas-only lifetimes are not autonomous mission endurance.
fields.proposed_next: Size the actual pack, controls, wiring and thermal duty for the chosen service interval; retain daily ground-service baseline until supported.
